public.title: Non-overlapping Intervals
public.description: Return the minimum number of intervals to remove so the remaining intervals do not overlap. Each [start,end] has integer start strictly less than end. Touching endpoints do not overlap. There are 0 to 500 intervals with endpoints from -10000 to 10000.
hints: Keep the compatible interval ending earliest.
public.attribution: Original statement, examples, tests and solutions authored for Bekor, 2026. Uses a standard algorithmic pattern; no third-party exercise text used.

explanation: Earliest-finish greedy leaves the greatest opportunity for future intervals. Removed count is total minus kept. O(n log n) time and O(n) copied space.
